title: Warm Crispy Indian Eggplant Baingan Bharta
description: A citrusy and crispy solo dinner Indian dish featuring fromage blanc and pickle, served in a tagine pot. This gluten free friendly baingan bharta is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the eggplants in half lengthwise and scoop out the flesh, leaving about 1/4 inch thick shell.
Heat the ghee in a tagine pot over medium heat and add the cumin seeds.
Add the chopped pickle, salt, and black pepper to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Add the eggplant flesh to the pot and cook until it starts to soften.
Transfer the pot to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the pot from the oven and stir in the fromage blanc, lemon juice, and chopped cilantro.
Return the pot to the oven and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the eggplant is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
